duration.text: The Marine Science at Ocean University of China is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese/English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4305 USD/per year ￥ 31000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 2.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 3.Undergraduate school transcript 4.Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 5.Two letters of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 6.Study plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief. 7.Resume Written in Chinese or in English

requirements.text: 1.Applicant should hold a Bachelor's degree 2.Pass the entrance examination or tests
